entries.headline: Built a Pins video-downloader landing-page prototype
entries.summary: Added an SEO-focused landing page with a split hero, download demo, capability tabs with screen recordings, synced how-to content, FAQ, and structured data for SoftwareApplication, HowTo, and FAQPage.

entries.headline: Developed Pins product media and video-edit pipeline
entries.summary: Added a design-language system, edited how-it-works and demo videos, prototype variants, product screenshots, and supporting video-edit scripts for the Pins landing experience.

entries.headline: Added page-drawing and page-action capabilities to browser-click
entries.summary: Merged the implementation of Marks and Page Actions, allowing the assistant to draw annotations on webpages and perform controlled in-page actions such as scrolling, clicking, and typing.
